correctness.rationale: From T=X+Y and Skellam H=X−Y, E|H|=2λ(a+b) with a=e^(−2λ)I0(2λ), b=e^(−2λ)I1(2λ), c=a+b. Poisson size bias yields E[T|H|]=4λ²c+2λa. Hence means λ(1∓c), variances λ(1∓a−λc²), and exact D_L−D_U=2(b−λc³)/(1−c²). The key strict Bessel inequality is proved for every λ>0: c=E exp(−4λS), S~Beta(1/2,3/2); with G~Gamma(1/2,1),J~Gamma(3/2,1), Jensen conditional on S=G/(G+J) gives c<(1+2λ)^(-1/2). Bessel ODE identities give c′=−b/λ and b′=2c−(4+1/λ)b. F=b−λc³ positive near zero cannot have a first zero because there F′=c[2−(2+4λ)c²+3λc^4]>0 by the strict Laplace bound. Independently checked numerical moment formulas and F at λ=.001,.1,1,10,100,1000 using high-precision special functions; numerical samples are corroboration, not the all-λ proof. Correct variance reversal VarU−VarL=2λa. Leading endpoint rates follow standard Bessel expansions.
